arxiv-2012-01311.creator: Vladimir Iashin and Francesca Palermo ⋆, ​Gökhan Solak ⋆, ​Claudio Coppola ⋆
arxiv-2012-01311.description: Abstract Human-robot object handover is a key skill for the future of human-robot collaboration. CORSMAL 2020 Challenge focuses on the perception part of this problem: the robot needs to estimate the filling mass of a container held by a human.

arxiv-2201-02608.title: QN Optimization with Hessian Samples
arxiv-2201-02608.creator: Joy Azzam, Daniel P. Henderson, Benjamin W. Ong, Allan A. Struthers
arxiv-2201-02608.description: Abstract This article explores how to effectively incorporate curvature information generated using SIMD-parallel forward-mode Algorithmic Differentiation (AD) into unconstrained Quasi-Newton (QN) minimization of a smooth objective function, f f . Specifically, forward-mode AD can be used to generate block Hessian samples Y = ∇ 2 f ​ ( x ) ​ S Y=\nabla^{2}f(x)\,S whenever the gradient is evaluated.

arxiv-2301-10509.creator: Ana Caraiani, James Newton
arxiv-2301-10509.description: Abstract . In this paper, we establish the modularity of every elliptic curve E / F E/F , where F F runs over infinitely many imaginary quadratic fields, including ℚ ⁡ ( − d ) {\mathbb{Q}}(\sqrt{-d}) for d = 1 , 2 , 3 , 5 d=1,2,3,5 .

arxiv-2303-04692.title: Magnetic enhancement of baryon confinement modeled via a deformed Skyrmion Journal: Physics Letters B
arxiv-2303-04692.creator: Shi Chen, Kenji Fukushima, Zebin Qiu
arxiv-2303-04692.description: Abstract We discuss the baryon properties under a strong magnetic field. We adopt the Skyrme model and calculate the magnetic field dependence of the mass and the pressure distribution in the soliton. We elucidate a magnetically induced contribution to the pressure sum rule and interpret it as an extra confining force.

arxiv-2311-14898.title: HongTu: Scalable Full-Graph GNN Training on Multiple GPUs (via communication-optimized CPU data offloading) CCS: Information systems Data management systems CCS: Computing methodologies Parallel computing methodologies Journal: PACMMOD Volume: 1 4 (SIGMOD) 246 12 DOI: 10.1145/3626733
arxiv-2311-14898.creator: Qiange Wang, Yao Chen, Weng-Fai Wong, Bingsheng He
arxiv-2311-14898.description: Abstract . Full-graph training on graph neural networks (GNN) has emerged as a promising training method for its effectiveness. Full-graph training requires extensive memory and computation resources. To accelerate this training process, researchers have proposed employing multi-GPU processing. However the scalability of existing frameworks is limited as they necessitate maintaining the training data for every layer in GPU memory.

arxiv-2504-12210.title: Communication Optimization for Decentralized Learning atop Bandwidth-limited Edge Networks Thanks: This work was supported by the National Science Foundation under award CNS-2106294.
arxiv-2504-12210.creator: Tingyang Sun, Tuan Nguyen, and Ting He
arxiv-2504-12210.description: Abstract Decentralized federated learning (DFL) is a promising machine learning paradigm for bringing artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities to the network edge. Running DFL on top of edge networks, however, faces severe performance challenges due to the extensive parameter exchanges between agents.

arxiv-2507-15810.title: Empirical Likelihood Based Inference for a Divergence Measure Based on Survival Extropy Thanks: Corresponding author email: skkkattu@isichennai.res.in
arxiv-2507-15810.creator: Naresh Garg a,b , Isha Dewan a and Sudheesh Kumar Kattumannil c a Statistical Science Unit, Indian Statistical Institute, Delhi, India, b Probabilistic Machine Learning Group, Aalto University, Espoo, Finland, c Applied Statistics Unit, Indian Statistical Institute, Chennai, India
arxiv-2507-15810.description: Abstract . We consider a divergence measure based on survival extropy and derive its non-parametric estimators based on U-statistics, empirical distribution-functions, and kernel density. Further, we construct confidence intervals for the divergence measure using the jackknife empirical likelihood (JEL) method and the normal approximation method with a jackknife pseudo-value-based variance estimator.

arxiv-2508-14872.title: High to low temperature: O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) model at large N N
arxiv-2508-14872.creator: Justin R. David, Srijan Kumar
arxiv-2508-14872.description: Abstract We study the O ⁡ ( N ) O(N) vector model for scalars with quartic interaction at large N N on S 1 × S 2 S^{1}\times S^{2} without the singlet constraint. The non-trivial fixed point of the model is described by a thermal mass satisfying the gap equation at large N N .

pmc-11425821.title: Synergistic Degradation of Methylene Blue by Hydrodynamic Cavitation Combined with Hydrogen Peroxide/Vitamin C System
pmc-11425821.creator: Yan Cao, Guoqiang Wu, Yongchun Huang, Chengdu Huang
pmc-11425821.description: In this study, a new combined process of hydrodynamic cavitation (HC) and a hydrogen peroxide/vitamin C (H2O2/Vc) system was proposed for the degradation of methylene blue (MB) in wastewater. An impact-jet hydraulic cavitator was used as the cavitation generation equipment, and H2O2/Vc was selected as a homogeneous oxidation system. The degradation characteristics of MB were investigated.

pmc-11510912.title: Molecular Identification and Bioinformatics Analysis of Anaplasma marginale Moonlighting Proteins as Possible Antigenic Targets
pmc-11510912.creator: Rosa Estela Quiroz-Castañeda, Hugo Aguilar-Díaz, Eduardo Coronado-Villanueva, Diego Israel Catalán-Ochoa, Itzel Amaro-Estrada, Alina Rodriguez-Mallon, Alejandro Cabezas-Cruz, Sara Moutailler
pmc-11510912.description: Background: Diseases of veterinary importance, such as bovine Anaplasmosis, cause significant economic losses. Due to this, the study of various proteins of the causal agent Anaplasma marginale has focused on surface proteins. However, a vaccine for this disease is not yet available.

pmc-11795467.title: Early diagnosis of oral submucous fibrosis using salivary 8-OHDG and 8-Isoprostane
pmc-11795467.creator: Bireswar Roy, Shaili Ghosh, SS Mohamed Abdulcader Riyaz, Madhvika Patidar, Urmi Mehta, Priya Agarwal, Pushkar Gupta
pmc-11795467.description: Oral submucous fibrosis (OSMF) is a condition that may be cancerous. The prognosis of OSMF is determined by a number of biomarkers, including 8-hydroxy 2' de-oxy-guanosine and 8-isoprostane. It is possible to assess the levels of 8-OHdG and 8-isoprostane in blood and saliva.

pmc-12442887.title: C.R.A.B.: a gamified paradigm for studying readiness potential
pmc-12442887.creator: Evgeny Blagovechtchenski, Maria Koriakina, Ksenia Bartseva, Alexandra Kuznetsova, Aleksandr Kirsanov, Sofia Ponomareva, Alena Popyvanova, Ekaterina Pomelova
pmc-12442887.description: BackgroundThis study presents a novel paradigm termed Contrasting Routines Affecting Bereitschaftspotential (C.R.A.B.), designed to analyze readiness potential (RP) waveforms preceding movements across varying experimental settings. This paradigm continues Libet's work on decision-making, with an emphasis on the motor planning component like in classical Libet experiment.

pmc-12736324.title: Diagnostic Approaches for Measles Virus: Methods, Advances, and Ongoing Challenges
pmc-12736324.creator: Yuan-Chao Xue, Ping Ren, Jasper Fuk-Woo Chan, Vivian Huiping Shuai
pmc-12736324.description: Measles, also known as rubeola, is a highly contagious and potentially life-threatening disease caused by the measles virus. It classically presents with fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a maculopapular rash. Despite the availability of an effective vaccine for decades, measles outbreaks continue to occur globally, largely driven by declining vaccination coverage and increased international travel.
